item.title: Teeth, finger bones and blessings: Buddhist relics inspire belief
item.description: ROSEMEAD, Calif. (AP) — Every Lunar New Year, the Wei Mountain Temple in Rosemead, California, publicly displays what it calls the “10,000 Buddha Relics," though the actual number contained in several glass display cases and miniature stupas or reliquaries is far larger, according to the temple’s founder, Master YongHua.
